summary: Defines the Robust XML Encoding Rules (RXER), a set of ASN.1 encoding rules that produce an XML representation of values of any ASN.1 data type. It also defines a canonical form. It is an experimental protocol.

eli5.summary: Computers describe data using a strict format. This note turns that data into readable XML tags, always in the same careful way.

questions: how to encode asn.1 as xml
